WelcomeHeroSubtitle: Set up Microsoft Teams Phone for a customer, one guided step at a time.
WelcomeStepExportDescription: Keep a record of what changed
GetStartedSubtitle: Run a short readiness check before you configure a customer. You can pause after any step and return later.
GetStartedModulesDescription: Verify that Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Graph PowerShell modules are installed.
GetStartedTeamsDescription: Establish a secure connection to your Microsoft Teams tenant. A sign-in window may appear.
GetStartedGraphDescription: Connect to Microsoft Graph to manage groups and phone resources. A browser sign-in window will open.
GetStartedAllSystemsReadyDescription: You have successfully connected to all required services.
WizardSidebarSubtitle: A safe, reviewable setup for each customer
WizardReviewSnapshotHint: Need to change something? Use Edit Configuration, then return here to review again.
WizardPreviewChangesTooltip: Preview every object that would be created, with resolved names, UPNs, numbers, and settings. No tenant changes are made.
WizardExportPlanJsonTooltip: Export the plan as JSON for change-approval workflows.
WizardExportPlanCsvTooltip: Export the plan as CSV for change-approval workflows.
VariablesSubtitle: Define variables for your Teams Phone setup: customer details, hours, holidays, and more.
VariablesConfigureCallFlowsHint: Configure greeting texts and actions for the default and after-hours call flows.
VariablesUsePerDayScheduleToggle: Use per-day schedule instead of one Mon-Fri schedule
VariablesConfigureHoursPerDayHint: Configure hours for each day individually:
VariablesManageHolidaySeriesHint: Click to manage multiple holiday dates and times.
VariablesHolidayGreetingExample: Example: Herzlich Willkommen bei der Acme Corp. Leider können wir Ihren Anruf derzeit nicht entgegennehmen, da Sie uns an einem Feiertag anrufen.
VariablesSelectHolidayTimeDescription: Choose a time that aligns with 15-minute boundaries:
VariablesManageHolidaySeriesDescription: Add, edit, or remove holiday dates and times. Each holiday will be created with the specified date and time.
VariablesHolidaySeriesDefaultTimeHint: If no time is selected, 00:00 will be used by default.
VariablesSetExplicitEndDateToggle: Set explicit end date and time
VariablesTeamsDefaultEndTimeHint: If not set, Teams defaults to the next day at 12:00.
VariablesAargauHolidayReferenceDescripti: Use this reference image because holidays in Aargau can vary each year. Check the official page of the DEPARTEMENT VOLKSWIRTSCHAFT UND INNERES, Amt fur Wirtschaft und Arbeit of Kanton Aargau for the newest list.
VariablesGreetingAndMusicTitle: Greeting text and music on hold
VariablesMaximumCallsReachedHint: Applied when the maximum number of calls is reached
VariablesCallTimesOutHint: Applied when a call times out
VariablesApplyToNewIncomingCallsToggle: Apply settings only to new incoming calls
VariablesNoAgentsAvailableHint: Applied when no agents are available
DashboardSubtitle: A read-only, live view of your telephony topology: auto attendants, call queues, resource accounts, phone numbers, and groups, with relationships and unlinked objects.
DashboardSearchWatermark: Search by name, number, or UPN
DashboardNoTopologyLoaded: No topology loaded yet. Connect to Teams and Graph, then press Refresh.
DashboardSelectRelationshipHint: Select an auto attendant or call queue to see its relationships.
DashboardReadOnlyFooter: Read-only view. No changes are made to the tenant.
DocumentationSubtitle: Export a complete overview of your Teams Phone configuration: routing topology, phone numbers, users, schedules, and more.
DocumentationWatermark: Click "Export report" to generate a complete tenant overview with routing topology, phone numbers, users, schedules, and configuration details...
DocumentationFooter: The export queries your tenant live via PowerShell. Ensure you are connected before exporting.
HistorySubtitle: A persistent audit trail of operations performed against your tenants. Records are stored locally as JSON lines, one file per tenant.
ProvisioningLoadResourceAccountsTooltip: Load resource accounts from Microsoft Teams
ProvisioningCreateResourceAccountTooltip: Open the dialog to create a resource account
ProvisioningNoResourceAccountsLoadedDesc: Use 'Load Resource Accounts' to load data from Teams.
ProvisioningStep2Description: Set the usage location for the resource account. This is required for licensing.
ProvisioningStep3Description: Assign a license to the resource account. This is required for the resource account to work.
ProvisioningCreateResourceAccountDescrip: The values are generated from your configuration. You can modify them if needed.
ProvisioningUpdateUsageLocationDescripti: This updates the usage location for the resource account. The value is taken from your configuration.
M365GroupsSubtitle: Search and manage M365 Groups for your Teams Phone setup.
M365GroupsEmptyDescription: Use 'Load Groups' to load data from your tenant.
M365GroupsConfirmConfigurationDescriptio: Confirm that you have configured all required values on the Configuration page before you continue.
M365GroupsAutoGeneratedHint: The group name is generated from your configuration. You can modify it if needed.
CallQueuesSubtitle: Manage resource accounts, call queues, and guided setup.
CallQueuesLoadTooltip: Load call queues from Microsoft Teams
CallQueuesCreateTooltip: Open the dialog to create a call queue
CallQueuesEmptyDescription: Use 'Load Call Queues' to load data from Teams.
CallQueuesGuidedSetupIntro: Follow these steps to create a complete call queue setup.
CallQueuesStep1Description: Create a resource account for the call queue. This account provides the call queue endpoint.
CallQueuesStep4Description: Load the M365 Group ID from the group name. This is required before you create the call queue.
CallQueuesStep5Description: Create the call queue with its routing settings and distribution list.
CallQueuesStep6Description: Assign the resource account to the call queue to complete the setup.
CallQueuesCreateDialogNote: Load the M365 Group ID before you create the call queue.
CallQueuesCreateDialogDescription: The call queue name is generated from your configuration. Use 'Load M365 Group ID' to retrieve the group ID.
CallQueuesAssignDialogTitle: Assign Resource Account to Call Queue
CallQueuesAssignDialogDescription: This assigns the resource account to the call queue to complete the setup.
AutoAttendantsSubtitle: Manage resource accounts, auto attendants, and guided setup.
AutoAttendantsEmptyDescription: Use 'Load Auto Attendants' to load data from Teams.
AutoAttendantsGuidedSetupIntro: Follow these steps to create a complete auto attendant setup.
AutoAttendantsStep1Description: Create a resource account for the auto attendant. This account provides the auto attendant endpoint.
AutoAttendantsStep4Title: Step 4: Validate Call Queue Resource Account
AutoAttendantsStep4Description: Validate that the call queue resource account exists and can be used as the target for the auto attendant.
AutoAttendantsStep5Description: Create the forwarding target that the auto attendant will use.
AutoAttendantsStep6Description: Create the default call flow with menu options for the auto attendant.
AutoAttendantsStep7Title: Step 7: Create After Hours Call Flow
AutoAttendantsStep7Description: Create the after-hours call flow with a disconnect option.
AutoAttendantsStep8Description: Create the schedule that defines when the after-hours call flow is active.
AutoAttendantsStep9Title: Step 9: Link Schedule to Call Flow
AutoAttendantsStep9Description: Link the after-hours schedule to the after-hours call flow.
AutoAttendantsStep10Description: Create the auto attendant with all configured call flows and links.
AutoAttendantsStep11Description: Assign the resource account to the auto attendant to complete the setup.
AutoAttendantsCreateDialogDescription: The auto attendant name is generated from your configuration. Validate the call queue resource account before you create the auto attendant.
AutoAttendantsAssignDialogTitle: Assign Resource Account to Auto Attendant
AutoAttendantsAssignDialogDescription: This assigns the resource account to the auto attendant to complete the setup.
AutoAttendantsValidateDialogDescription: This validates that the call queue resource account exists and can be used as the target for the auto attendant. The value is generated from your configuration, but you can modify it if needed.
AutoAttendantsCreateForwardingTargetDesc: This creates the forwarding target that the auto attendant will use.
AutoAttendantsCreateDefaultCallFlowDescr: This creates the default call flow with menu options for the auto attendant.
AutoAttendantsCreateAfterHoursCallFlowDe: This creates the after-hours call flow with a disconnect option.
AutoAttendantsCreateAfterHoursScheduleDe: This creates the schedule that defines when the after-hours call flow is active.
AutoAttendantsLinkScheduleToCallFlowDesc: This links the after-hours schedule to the after-hours call flow.
HolidaysSubtitle: Create and manage holiday schedules for your auto attendants.
HolidaysGuidedSetupIntro: Follow these steps to create a holiday schedule for your auto attendant.
HolidaysStep1Description: Create the holiday schedule that the auto attendant will use. This defines when the holiday call flow is active.
HolidaysStep2Description: Verify that the auto attendant exists and is ready for the holiday configuration. You can modify the auto attendant name if needed.
HolidaysStep3Title: Step 3: Link Holiday to Auto Attendant
HolidaysStep3Description: Link the created holiday to the auto attendant. This creates the holiday call flow and associates it with the holiday schedule.
HolidaysCreateDialogDescription: Holidays are created from the configured holiday series on the Configuration page. Each holiday uses the specified date, time, and greeting prompt.
HolidaysCheckDialogDescription: This verifies that the auto attendant exists and is ready for the holiday configuration. The value is generated from your configuration, but you can modify it if needed.
HolidaysLinkDialogDescription: This links the created holiday to the auto attendant, creates the holiday call flow, and associates it with the holiday schedule.
